name: Ling 3.0 Tiny
short: InclusionAI's Aug 2026 MIT reasoning MoE at 7.9B total but 1.3B active (128K native, 256K YaRN): GPQA 73.4%, free $0 API, 8.34 GiB local footprint at ~100 tok/s.

freeTierNote: Free via API provider ($0 input / $0 output); MIT weights free self-host
standout: The efficiency play: real reasoning scores from 1.3B active parameters, free to run on a MacBook.
tradeoff: Terminal-Bench 2.1 27.7%, SciCode 24.2% and no SWE-bench or LiveCodeBench figure - a research-tier reasoning model.
